Finishing a reload within ? seconds of a Weapon Kill, or becoming <arc/>Amplified, grants 1 stack of 'Gear Shift' for #e${15} seconds. Maximum of 5 stacks.

Grants 15%|20%|25%|30%|35% increased damage at 1|2|3|4|5 stacks.

Buff can be triggered while stowed and refreshed with each new application of <arc/>Amplified.
